call_points.text: Management targets FY27 EBITDA margin in the 9% to 10% range and double digits from FY28 onwards.
call_points.versus_prior: lower than conf. in sustaining double digits in FY26 call

call_points.text: Management expects H2FY27 revenue growth to exceed 30% YoY.
All sales, marketing, and product development expenses are being fully loaded into current P&L rather than capitalized.
Supply chain shortages and long lead times in memory components continue to create execution friction.
Completed integration of Altek Electronics and renamed it as Cyient DLM Electronics, Inc.

call_points.versus_prior: New guidance, no earlier target in memory

call_points.text: FY26 reported EBITDA margin improved 103 bps YoY to 10.1%, with management confident of sustaining double digits.
Q4 revenue was deferred due to West Asia cargo disruption, customer clearance delays, and memory component availability.
Net working capital days remain elevated due to buffer inventory of long-lead parts; long-term target is 100-120 days.
Defense vertical revenue dropped 68% YoY in FY26 due to completion of a large contract in FY25.
Commenced series supply for a new automotive product line and series production for a semiconductor equipment partner.
Build-to-spec defense client scaling is targeted for late FY27 and FY28.

guidance.statement: we expect margins remain at the higher end of the single-digit range for FY27 [9% to 10%]
if you look at for the H2, we'll definitely going above 30% growth.

operating_notes.text: Total FY26 order intake surpassed $208 million.
Rest of World accounts for over 90% of revenue driven by export markets.
PCBA accounted for approximately 48% of Q4FY26 revenue.
Order book reached an all-time high of ₹2,813.7 Cr
Order book reached an all-time high of ₹2,813.7 Cr in Q2FY27.
Book-to-bill ratio stood at 1.6 in Q2FY27.
Reported PAT includes a one-off gain of ₹18.2 Cr from an earnout reversal.
Bid pipeline stands in excess of $1 billion with historical win conversion rate around 40%.
Four electronic product (B2S) programs represent ~$1 billion potential pipeline over 7-9 years with full scale production expected from FY30.

Cyient DLM held its Q4FY26 earnings call, reporting a record order book of ₹2,416.6 Cr (1.5x book-to-bill) and a $500M pipeline.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹393.09 Cr (+26.5% YoY), net profit ₹34.01 Cr (+5.8% YoY).
Cyient DLM reported Q2FY27 results with revenue up 26.5% YoY to ₹393.1 Cr and normalized PAT up 25.8% YoY to ₹15.8 Cr.
Cyient DLM reported Q2FY27 revenue growth of 26.5% YoY to ₹393.1 Cr and reached a record order book of ₹2,813.7 Cr.
Cyient DLM held its Q2FY27 concall, guiding for 9-10% FY27 EBITDA margin and >30% H2 revenue growth backed by a ₹2,813.7 Cr order book.

watchlist.text: Shareholder approval for re-appointment of Mr. B.V.R Mohan Reddy

watchlist.response: Management declined to give a specific revenue growth number for FY27, but stated that West Asia air cargo delays and customer approvals deferred revenue into Q1FY27.

status_history.evidence: Management clarified that H2FY27 growth will exceed 30% supported by ₹2,813.7 Cr order book and explained margin pressure due to SG&A/product spend.

watchlist.text: Analyst questioned why revenue did not match previous Q3 growth guidance, pointing to flat conversion of order backlog.

watchlist.response: CFO explained that other expenses reflect the consolidation of US and India operations and contain fixed costs that will display operating leverage as volumes recover.
watchlist.text: Analyst asked for explanation on why other expenses surged significantly despite an overall 17% drop in FY26 revenue.
